controls: 64 joint-date shuffled breadth vectors within era AND identical past-ready peer universe/finite mask; finite label support fixed; singleton strata stay unchanged

protocol.stop: If gate fails, do not fit a controller or tune breadth/fast/slow/horizon. Preserve direction capability and select another information source from evidence.
